item.mtfodmod.pregabalin_capsule.lore1: Sedation, dizziness, ataxia — high-dose abuse causes severe drowsiness or coma.
item.mtfodmod.pregabalin_capsule.lore2: Long-term abuse leads to dependence and withdrawal symptoms.
item.mtfodmod.dextromethorphan.lore1: High doses cause dissociation and hallucinations; may trigger serotonin syndrome.
item.mtfodmod.dextromethorphan.lore2: Abuse impairs cognition; large doses risk psychosis and arrhythmia.
item.mtfodmod.amantadine.lore1: High doses cause stimulation and hallucinations; may lead to psychosis or seizures.
item.mtfodmod.amantadine.lore2: Overdose can cause arrhythmia or cardiac arrest.
item.mtfodmod.gabapentin_capsule.lore1: Sedation, dizziness, ataxia; potentiates respiratory depression with opioids.
item.mtfodmod.gabapentin_capsule.lore2: Abuse causes dependence; withdrawal includes anxiety and insomnia.
item.mtfodmod.estradiol_valerate.lore1: An estrogen medication used in hormone replacement therapy (HRT).
item.mtfodmod.estradiol_valerate.lore2: Take it as prescribed; do not self-medicate or abuse it.
item.mtfodmod.yumei_tablet.lore1: A cough medicine containing dextromethorphan; high-dose abuse causes dissociation and hallucinations.
item.mtfodmod.yumei_tablet.lore2: Abuse can trigger serotonin syndrome, psychosis and arrhythmia.
item.mtfodmod.androcur_50mg.lore1: An anti-androgen used in MtF hormone therapy (HRT).
item.mtfodmod.androcur_50mg.lore2: Take it as prescribed; do not self-medicate or abuse it.
advancement.mtfodmod.first_od.title: First OD
advancement.mtfodmod.first_od.descriptio: Took an abused drug for the first time. Remember: overdose (OD) can cost your life.
